title: Transfer of boundary depth from a finite structure algebra to the source local rings
statement: Let $L$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $U\subseteq L$ open, and $\mathcal A$ a sheaf of commutative $\mathcal O_L$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf]. Assume that for every $y\notin U$ its stalk $\mathcal A_y$, as a module over $\mathcal O_{L,y}$ through the stalk of its structure map, is finite and has depth at least two [def-weil-pbc-depth]. Let $p:E\to L$ be finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and supply an isomorphism $\alpha:\mathcal A\cong p_*\mathcal O_E$ of $\mathcal O_L$-algebras. Then $\operatorname{depth}\mathcal O_{E,z}\geq2$ for every $z\in E$ with $p(z)\notin U$. No cover, etaleness, or depth hypothesis on the base local rings is required.

source.place: Tag 0AUK, applied to the finite direct image algebra as in the proof of Tag 0EY6(2)

proof.text: At y = p(z), apply the stalk functor to the supplied isomorphism of structure algebras. Under.w guarantees compatibility with the base stalk action. This gives an algebra equivalence from A_y to B = (p_* O_E)_y. Transport finite generation and depth across its underlying linear equivalence. The private linear-equivalence helper proves depth invariance for every ideal over an arbitrary commutative ring by transporting ideal multiples and regular sequences; specialize it to the base maximal ideal.

Let g:B -> O_E,z be the canonical stalkPushforward homomorphism and q the inverse image of the maximal ideal of O_E,z. The localness of p.stalkMap shows that q contracts to the maximal ideal of O_L,y. Choose an affine open U around y; p is affine because it is finite. With S = Gamma(E,p^{-1}U), the affine pushforward stalk theorem identifies B as a localization of S at the image of functions not vanishing at y. The affine source stalk theorem identifies O_E,z as S localized at its point prime. The first denominator monoid is contained in the second because its elements become units in O_E,z. IsLocalization.isLocalization_of_submonoid_le therefore makes O_E,z a localization of B at the image of the second monoid. Enlarge this monoid to B minus q using IsLocalization.of_le; all its elements map to units by the definition of q. Uniqueness of localization gives B_q isomorphic to O_E,z.

For every B-regular sequence with scalars in the maximal ideal of O_L,y, change scalars along O_L,y -> B to obtain a weakly regular sequence in B contained in q. Localize using the Mathlib weakly-regular-sequence localization theorem to obtain a regular sequence of the same length in B_q, with all entries in its maximal ideal. The base maximal ideal does not generate B because its extension lies in the proper prime q. Taking suprema of sequence lengths proves depth over O_L,y of B <= depth of B_q (also for infinite depth). The private ring-equivalence helper transports depth for any proper ideal of an arbitrary commutative ring to its image ideal. Proper ideals do not generate the ring as a module over itself, and ring equivalences preserve properness, regular sequences and lengths. Specialize this inequality to the maximal ideal of B_q and use the Mathlib maximal-ideal transport theorem to pass across B_q isomorphic to O_E,z. Compose with the supplied depth >= 2 bound. Only this lower inequality from Tag 0AUK is needed, not the full minimum-depth formula or maximality of q.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0AUK, lower-bound direction, as used in Tag 0EY6(2)

lean.statement:
theorem depth_two_of_finite_structure_algebra
    {L : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian L] (U : L.Opens)
    (A : L.CommAlgebraSheaf)
    (hdepth : ∀ y : L, y ∉ U →
      letI : Algebra (L.presheaf.stalk y)
            ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor CommRingCat y).obj A.right.obj) :=
          ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor CommRingCat y).map A.hom.hom).hom.toAlgebra
      ∃ hfinite : Module.Finite (L.presheaf.stalk y)
            ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor CommRingCat y).obj A.right.obj),
        letI := hfinite
        (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := L.presheaf.stalk y)
            ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor CommRingCat y).obj A.right.obj))
    {E : Scheme.{u}} (p : E ⟶ L) [IsFinite p]
    (α : A ≅ Under.mk
      (⟨p.c⟩ : L.sheaf ⟶ (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward CommRingCat.{u} p.base).obj E.sheaf)) :
    ∀ z : E, p z ∉ U →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := E.presheaf.stalk z) (E.presheaf.stalk z)
